chunks: The one who guides to good is like the one who does it.

key_terms.الْخَيْرِ: goodness, righteous action, and beneficial conduct
key_terms.اَلدَّالُّ عَلَى الْخَيْرِ: the one who directs or guides others toward goodness
key_terms.كَفَاعِلِهِ: like the one who actually performs it in reward and virtue

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for guiding someone to do good in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that directing others toward goodness carries a reward comparable to performing that good oneself. It highlights the virtue of encouraging righteous action and spreading benefit among people.
